geodesic.softmin: control original -temperature*logsumexp(-through/temperature); candidate -temperature*(logsumexp(-through/temperature)-log(4)). Apply normalization at EACH relaxation before minimum(distance,relaxed).
geodesic.normalization_reason: Fourfold intermediate-node sampling otherwise changes unnormalized softmin by -temperature*log4 even for exactly duplicated coarse nodes. Fixed quadrature correction, no GT calibration.
geodesic.limitations: Top-k cardinality preserves area budget, not identical selected physical neighbors. Three geodesic iterations remain the same algorithm. This is resolution adaptation with stated geometry changes, not a node-count-only causal test.

training.aggregation: Each per-image total /16 backward; zero_grad once per logical batch; clip global eligible norm1 once after all16; Adam step once. Log averaged per-image parts, no mean-over-batch density before squaring.

evaluation.freeze: Freeze both complete predicted-label arrays before GT scoring.

evaluation.prediction_ties: Background wins if tied; otherwise native component with larger total area wins, then component with smallest native row-major node wins. Uses prediction only and is invariant to arbitrary component ID renaming.
evaluation.native_secondary: Score candidate native32 against modal4-pixel32-grid GT. Separately nearest-repeat control16 predictions to32 and score on the SAME32-grid GT. Do not compare native32 metrics directly to historical16-grid metrics.

Historical16-grid Slot means support only the primary16-grid comparison; no Slot retraining or native32 superiority claim without this evaluation.
